title: Chip design software maker Synopsys reaches a deal with Elliott, giving one board seat to the activist investor's Jesse Cohn, after roughly two months of talks (Svea Herbst-Bayliss/Reuters)
summary: Svea Herbst-Bayliss / Reuters: Chip design software maker Synopsys reaches a deal with Elliott, giving one board seat to the activist investor's Jesse Cohn, after roughly two months of talks — Chip design software maker Synopsys (SNPS.O) has reached an agreement with activist investor Elliott Investment Management …
